# Code of Conduct

Participants must respect one another and maintain a safe, collaborative environment regardless of experience,
role, nationality, gender, disability, religion, or other identity. Welcome behavior includes specific,
constructive feedback, correcting mistakes, and considering users and field operators. Insults, discrimination,
threats, harassment, and disclosure of personal information are not accepted.

Report problems privately to a maintainer. Maintainers share only what is necessary and apply warnings,
participation limits, content removal, or suspension consistently. For an immediate safety hazard, follow the
site's emergency procedure and contact the appropriate public authority first.
